messages:
nora: starting war room — customers are reporting a sudden burst of 504s and some 502s on hosted inference, started ~14:07 UTC. Posting here to coordinate.

priya: Support logged 22 tickets in the last 12 minutes. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Some customers see partial responses then disconnects.

tony: Observability: gateway 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% to 9% at 14:06. Downstream RPC latency to model-rpc doubled; pod restarts on pool-b at 14:08.

sam: Any recent infra/dev changes?

deploy-bot: deploy eng/runtime v3.0.7 started 14:00 UTC, finished 14:04 UTC on pool-b.

priya: Notifying high-SLA customers now with interim message.

nora: Ops, please increase gateway concurrency and open more workers in pool-b. Also, can we divert traffic to fallback zone us-west?

tony: Scaling up gateway replicas and increasing max in-flight from 250 -> 400. Triggering a soft-failover of traffic to us-west for non-SLA customers.

ops-bot: failover route created for service-group: hosted-inference-non-sla -> us-west at 14:12 UTC.

sam: I pulled recent runtime changelog: v3.0.7 included a change to request pre-processing which touched buffer allocation and kernel hints. Could be related.

nora: Priority mitigation plan: 1) roll forward safety toggles (disable new buffer allocator) 2) restart unhealthy worker pods in small batches 3) prevent failed calls from contributing to quota counts 4) prepare RCA owners.

sam: Quick repro I ran from CLI:

```curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-8k","input":"test","max_tokens":1024}'
```
Response: 504 with headers: `x-gateway-timeout: 1`. Gateway log snippet: `ERROR proxy: upstream call timeout after 30s`

sam: Worker logs show out-of-memory reclaims then RPC disconnects. Example: `2024-08-09T14:06:18Z WARN mem: swap in use, rss 52GB (limit 48GB)` and `2024-08-09T14:06:19Z ERROR rpc: write failed: broken pipe`

priya: Billing question: several customers said they were charged for failed attempts. Can billing team suppress charges and apply credits?

billing-bot: Queued credit review for timeframe 14:00-14:20 UTC for SLA customers. Manual approval required.

nora: Rolling restart of pool-b workers started. Doing 4 pods at a time with 90s delay between batches.

priya: Sending an update to affected customers: "We are aware of increased timeouts affecting hosted inference. We've rolled back a recent runtime change and restarted affected workers. We're working on credits for failed requests where applicable."

tony: After toggling allocator opt-out and completing two restart batches, error rate dropped 75% but not zero. There remain some transient 502s from lingering connections to old binary.

sam: I confirmed that the allocator change increases per-request scratch buffer by ~30%, which on certain model + batch size combos can push RSS above container limit causing kernel to swap and then trigger RPC timeouts.

nora: Action items to capture now: A) Reproduce in staging with same traffic profile and model combos — owner: Sam (due: 48h) B) Add preflight memory estimate step in runtime that refuses large buffer allocations, returning 503 rather than letting worker crash — owner: Eng-runtime (Priya) C) Autoscaler policy review to avoid tight headroom — owner: Ops (Tony) D) Billing: auto-refund failed 5xx calls during incident windows for SLA customers — owner: Billing (billing-bot / finance) E) Release process: block allocator/runtime changes from spanning full rollout without memory smoke tests — owner: Eng-release (nora)

priya: Assigning owners: Sam will draft RCA; Tony will post autoscaler proposal by EOD; Billing will confirm credit posting timeline by EOD.

support-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20240809-HOSTED-5XX. Priority: P1. Notifications sent to on-call.

nora: For the postmortem please include: full timeline, affected customer counts and SLA mapping, exact commit that introduced change (commit: b7c2f1a), heap/profile samples, and proposed permanent mitigations.

tony: Also add an alert rule: worker RSS > 80% for > 2m -> page eng-runtime and ops. Currently only > 90% triggers.

sam: Temporary mitigation: mark v3.0.7 as blocked for pool-b and re-deploy v3.0.6. I'm coordinating with release to schedule that if restarts don't complete.

priya: Customer update pushed at 14:31 UTC with apology and link to status page.

billing-bot: Manual credits posted for 3 SLA customers at 15:05 UTC; finance to reconcile.

nora: Error rate returned to baseline at 15:10 UTC after final restarts and toggles. Closing war room later; keep this thread open for RCA drafts.

support-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED at 15:11 UTC. Root cause summary: runtime buffer-allocation change increased memory usage on certain model configs leading to OOM/swap and gateway timeouts.

nora: Thank you all. Follow-up meeting scheduled for 2024-08-11 15:00 UTC to review RCA and deployment gating. Please add any leftover action items to the postmortem doc. :heart:
